hermeticity.method: Built a focus-only baseline from 100:2 and its two branch inventories, then read context_root_cues in packet order as possible activators.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed hermetic trace because the packet supplies focus and context together; no gold, prior outputs, external tafsir, or other files were consulted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًا: مُورِيَٰتِ from و ر ي and قَدْحًا from ق د ح.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hidden fire is made manifest by a forceful strike; the participle names agents whose action draws latent flame out of resistant matter.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Latent fire in a fire-stick becomes visible.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the hidden combustible content.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Striking produces ignition.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the causal trigger that extracts the fire.

changed_reading.before: A simple oath-image: spark-makers striking sparks.
changed_reading.after: A process-image: latent force is locked inside matter and becomes visible only through impact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَدْحًا can be flawing/scoring, while مُورِيَٰتِ keeps an interior hiddenness beside its fire sense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The strike may not merely illuminate; it may score, puncture, or blemish the struck surface, making the spark a visible sign of damage.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The act of striking can score or flaw a thing.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Recasts the spark as a wound-mark rather than pure light.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: داء يأكل الجوف أو يصيب الرئة
activation_trace.literal_contribution: The root can name an inward injury or eating disease.

changed_reading.before: The line shows bright sparks thrown off by motion.
changed_reading.after: The line can also show impact leaving a diagnostic wound: light appears as the surface evidence of inner harm.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُورِيَٰتِ and قَدْحًا together invite fire-stick idioms of success and deliberate undertaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fire-stick that catches becomes a model for achieving an intended result; the strike is an act of considering, testing, and making an enterprise take.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A fire-stick that takes can signify success, aid, or defense.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Turns ignition into achieved intent.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: An affair is examined and planned.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Adds deliberation behind the physical strike.

changed_reading.before: Spark-making is a raw sensory event.
changed_reading.after: Spark-making becomes a figure for an undertaking made to catch: impact plus planning yields result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior rushing and panting make 100:2 less like hand-kindling and more like combustion generated by speed, breath, stretched bodies, heat, and abrasive contact.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Hidden fire emerges under friction.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Focus image to be mechanically activated.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Striking ignites.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Impact mechanism.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Racing or running at speed.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the velocity that makes striking plausible.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible panting or harsh breath.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Adds bodily heat and exertion to the ignition scene.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Burning at the tips of wood.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Bridges panting exertion to singed material contact.

structural_cues: Both ayat use active feminine plural participles followed by accusative verbal-noun-like images.

abductive_moves.assumption: Speed plus impact can be read as the cause of spark-making.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Running, panting, hidden fire, and striking-fire branch images.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The sparks are generated by the motion of the runners rather than by a separate hand-held tool.
alternatives: The first ayah could be only sequential description, not causation.
The fire-stick image may remain idiomatic rather than literal hoof-friction.

changed_reading.after: 100:2 is the thermal consequence of the previous rushing body: breath, speed, and contact turn latent fire outward.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 100:1, the fire-stick model remains but loses the sense of bodily velocity and singed extremities causing ignition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following morning and change/alteration cues turn the spark into a threshold-flash: not campfire stability, but a brief ignition at the moment a hidden night condition becomes morning action.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Something can be hidden or shown under another face.

strongest_changes: 100:1 changes the focus spark from hand-kindling to kinetic combustion caused by rushing, panting, and singed contact.
100:4 changes the spark into a trace-event: impact disturbs matter, producing fire, dust, and evidentiary marks.
100:9-10 retrospectively make 100:2 a miniature disclosure of hidden interiors: covered fire, graves, chests, and extracted contents belong to one uncovering mechanism.
100:6-8 moralize the physical flash as the exposure of ingratitude, cut relation, and hardened love of gain.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually overdetermined: its two roots already contain fire, concealment, wounding, disease, social aspersion, planning, lots, cups, and plant tips, so context does not replace the fire image but opens several latent readings in parallel.
remaining_uncertainties: How far the non-dominant split mappings should influence final prose, especially ء ث ر in 100:4 and the qadah-lot echo under ر ب ب.
Whether the disease/decay interior reading should be rendered as commentary or kept as a diagnostic latent resonance.
Whether the opening agents should remain concrete animals/raiders or be allowed to become generalized mechanisms of disclosure.
